estimand: Exploratory prediction error for finishing-phase DMI summaries of beef steers from a new experiment represented by this source; not mature beef cows on pasture.
limitations: Only five independent experiments are available; the effective independent sample size is five trials, not 446 animals.
This is internal cross-experiment evaluation on one deposited source, not independent external validation.
ADG is a contemporaneous outcome and makes this a retrospective component prediction, not a prospective deployment model.
No mechanistic comparator is reported because the reviewed BR-CORTE equation targets growing Zebu cattle on tropical pasture, not finishing feedlot steers.

intervals.reason: No independent interval calibration data in this source.
